name: Braintree
description: Records Braintree transactions as InvoiceLeaf payments and allocates them to existing invoices matched by the transaction order ID. Braintree has no invoicing product, so no documents are imported.

apiKey.instructions: In the Braintree control panel, go to Settings > API Keys and copy your Private Key, then paste it here. The merchant ID, public key, and environment are entered in the integration settings, not here.

triggers.name: Sync Braintree Payments
triggers.description: Records settled Braintree transactions as payments and allocates them to invoices matched by order ID

actions.name: Test Braintree Connection
actions.description: Verify the API credentials can reach the Braintree GraphQL API and search transactions

merchantId.title: Merchant ID
merchantId.description: Your Braintree merchant ID (shown under Settings > Business in the control panel).

publicKey.title: Public Key
publicKey.description: Your Braintree API public key (shown under Settings > API Keys in the control panel).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Which Braintree environment the API keys belong to.

initialSyncLookbackHours.title: Initial Sync Lookback (hours)
initialSyncLookbackHours.description: Used only until the first successful run checkpoint is stored.

includeSubmittedForSettlement.title: Include Submitted For Settlement
includeSubmittedForSettlement.description: Also record transactions not yet settled (status SUBMITTED_FOR_SETTLEMENT).

matchByOrderId.title: Match By Order ID
matchByOrderId.description: When enabled, a transaction whose order ID equals the invoice number of exactly one InvoiceLeaf document is allocated to that document.

recordUnmatchedTransactions.title: Record Unmatched Transactions
recordUnmatchedTransactions.description: When enabled, transactions that cannot be matched to an invoice are still recorded as unmatched payments for manual reconciliation.
